Game Overview

At its heart, Idle Dairy Farm Tycoon is a farming game about build a thriving dairy empire from scratch. Raise cows, process and deliver milk, and automate your business for maximum profit. Upgrade workers and facilities to dominate the market in this relaxing yet strategic idle adventure. Perfect for fans of business simulation games.

Playing Idle Dairy Farm Tycoon comes down to a simple loop. Build a thriving dairy empire from scratch! Raise cows, process and deliver milk, and automate your business for maximum profit.
